contract: tenant_id is immutable and is the runtime isolation/security domain
organization_ref is immutable metadata/projection, not a second security domain
one owner_principal_id established atomically at bootstrap
Owner or Member only; membership grants visibility, never a Case role
every new Case is opened with exactly one tenant_id and cannot move
new lineage identity is tenant_id + policy_key
never merges Tenants or grants cross-Tenant visibility
one operation resolves exactly one Tenant context
v1-v7 Cases and v1-v4 artifacts remain readable as legacy_unscoped and cannot gain new authority
